what_happened: De-weeding of the lake by BDA (activists objected that weeds were removed completely)
Water diverted to Varthur through temporary channels; lake ~70% drained before desilting began 24 Apr 2020
Lake drained in early-mid February 2026 for desilting and bund work; inlets diverted
Lake (92 acres) drained in February 2026 for desilting; about 1 lakh m3 of silt to remove
Lake bund breached on 24 Nov 2019, flooding houses in Hulimavu and BTM Layout
Heavy rains filled the lake to the brim for the first time in 28 years (rain control: no event expected)
Cloudburst made the lake overflow for the first time in 17+ years (rain control: no event expected)
